title: The Phantom Orders
summary: A six-chapter synthetic incident investigation about duplicate successful charges.

chapters.title: Find duplicate successful payments
chapters.why: Establish which orders were charged more than once, counting successful charges only.

steps.why: Inspect the declared fictional Case and its evidence before solving.

steps.title: Investigate with the team, then debrief
steps.why: Read the fictional setup from the people on the case, open the pinned challenge in the real editor, and wait for a validated pass before the debrief continues.

steps.title: Solve the pinned challenge
steps.why: Write and submit the required SQL and typed answers in the real challenge editor. A validated whole-challenge pass also lets the guided debrief continue.
